commands.name: list-stories
commands.summary: List the latest front-page stories on Slashdot, with id, title, link, byline and summary.

commands.name: list-section-stories
commands.summary: List the stories on a section front page (subdomain such as science, yro, linux, hardware, developers, news).

commands.name: list-by-tag
commands.summary: List firehose items (stories and submissions) filtered by a tag or topic keyword, e.g. ubuntu, space, crime, medicine.

commands.name: list-recent-submissions
commands.summary: List the most recent user submissions to the firehose, with pagination. The summary starts with '<submitter> writes:'.

commands.name: get-story
commands.summary: Get a story's title, byline, summary text and firehose id. The story is identified by its sid date path yy/mm/dd/id.

commands.name: list-story-comments
commands.summary: List the comments shown on a story page (the default threshold view), with subject, author, score and text.

commands.name: fetch-all-comments
commands.summary: Fetch the full comment tree of a discussion through the site's AJAX endpoint (read-only, despite being a POST).

commands.name: list-polls
commands.summary: List Slashdot polls. Each summary has the comment count, question, vote count and posting date; the url holds the poll id for get-poll-results.

commands.name: get-poll-results
commands.summary: Get the results of a poll by id: each answer with its vote count and percentage.

commands.name: vote-poll
commands.summary: Cast a vote in a poll. This submits answer aid for poll qid, and Slashdot allows one vote per IP.

commands.name: get-user-activity
commands.summary: Get a user's profile page: their recent activity (comments, stories, submissions) with scores and links.

commands.name: list-user-comments
commands.summary: List a user's recent comments with subject, comment link, date and the story each is attached to.

commands.name: list-archive-stories
commands.summary: Browse the story archive: last week by default, or stories for a topic/section keyword and year, or by time for a year.

commands.name: get-rss-feed
commands.summary: Get the main Slashdot RSS (RDF) feed of current stories, with title, link, author, date and description.

results.reason: write: dry-run preview only, not sent
